caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica means learning when to stop turning the pedals. On tropical ridges, sudden gradients and clay soil turn riding into climbing—and the fastest line is often on foot, pushing your frame shoulder-to-shoulder with the mountain. There is no shame in hike-a-bike when the terrain demands reverence. Send this to the friend who knows that true endurance isn't just about the saddle.
